fork_stack_policy_active_idx.name: fork_stack_policy_active_idx
fork_stack_policy_active_idx.where: activated_at IS NOT NULL AND deactivated_at IS NULL

fork_stack_policy_quiesce_ck.name: fork_stack_policy_quiesce_ck
fork_stack_policy_quiesce_ck.value: "fork_stack_policy"."quiesce_enabled" = false OR ("fork_stack_policy"."quiesce_enabled_by" IS NOT NULL AND "fork_stack_policy"."quiesce_enabled_at" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length("fork_stack_policy"."quiesce_services") BETWEEN 1 AND 32)

fork_recovery_point_verified_ck.name: fork_recovery_point_verified_ck
fork_recovery_point_verified_ck.value: "fork_recovery_point"."status" <> 'verified' OR ("fork_recovery_point"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "fork_recovery_point"."downgrade_reason" IS NULL)

fork_kit_verified_ck.name: fork_kit_verified_ck
fork_kit_verified_ck.value: "fork_kit"."status" <> 'verified' OR ("fork_kit"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "fork_kit"."verified_type" IS NOT NULL)

fork_agent_enrollment_pending_ck.name: fork_agent_enrollment_pending_ck
fork_agent_enrollment_pending_ck.value: ("fork_agent_enrollment"."pending_credential_hash" IS NULL) = ("fork_agent_enrollment"."pending_task_id" IS NULL) AND ("fork_agent_enrollment"."pending_task_id" IS NULL) = ("fork_agent_enrollment"."pending_valid_until" IS NULL)

fork_agent_task_lease_ck.name: fork_agent_task_lease_ck
fork_agent_task_lease_ck.value: "fork_agent_task"."status" NOT IN ('leased', 'running') OR ("fork_agent_task"."lease_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fork_agent_task"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL)

fork_agent_task_final_ck.name: fork_agent_task_final_ck
fork_agent_task_final_ck.value: "fork_agent_task"."status" NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'rejected', 'expired', 'cancelled') OR "fork_agent_task"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

fork_restore_run_one_active_target_uq.name: fork_restore_run_one_active_target_uq
fork_restore_run_one_active_target_uq.where: state IN ('running','awaiting_approval') AND target_agent_id IS NOT NULL

fork_restore_run_test_facet_idx.name: fork_restore_run_test_facet_idx
fork_restore_run_test_facet_idx.where: purpose = 'test_restore' AND state = 'succeeded' AND verification = 'data_verified' AND wipe_state = 'verified'

fork_restore_run_wipe_ck.name: fork_restore_run_wipe_ck
fork_restore_run_wipe_ck.value: ("fork_restore_run"."wipe_state" IS NULL OR "fork_restore_run"."wipe_state" IN ('running','verified','not_needed','failed')) AND ("fork_restore_run"."wipe_reason" IS NULL OR "fork_restore_run"."wipe_reason" ~ '^[a-z_]{1,64}$')

fork_restore_run_failed_ck.name: fork_restore_run_failed_ck
fork_restore_run_failed_ck.value: "fork_restore_run"."state" NOT IN ('failed','incomplete') OR "fork_restore_run"."reason" IS NOT NULL

fork_tr_schedule_enabled_ck.name: fork_tr_schedule_enabled_ck
fork_tr_schedule_enabled_ck.value: NOT "fork_test_restore_schedule"."enabled" OR ("fork_test_restore_schedule"."enabled_by" IS NOT NULL AND "fork_test_restore_schedule"."enabled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "fork_test_restore_schedule"."target_agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fork_test_restore_schedule"."restore_root" IS NOT NULL)

fork_tr_schedule_reason_ck.name: fork_tr_schedule_reason_ck
fork_tr_schedule_reason_ck.value: ("fork_test_restore_schedule"."last_reason" IS NULL OR "fork_test_restore_schedule"."last_reason" ~ '^[a-z_]{1,64}$') AND ("fork_test_restore_schedule"."pause_reason" IS NULL OR "fork_test_restore_schedule"."pause_reason" ~ '^[a-z_]{1,64}$')

fork_mirror_revision_one_active_runner_u.name: fork_mirror_revision_one_active_runner_uq
fork_mirror_revision_one_active_runner_u.where: state IN ('requested','planning','validating','staging','restoring_files','transforming','restoring_db','starting','healthchecking') AND runner_agent_id IS NOT NULL

fork_mirror_revision_port_runner_uq.name: fork_mirror_revision_port_runner_uq
fork_mirror_revision_port_runner_uq.where: runner_agent_id IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(wipe_state, '') NOT IN ('verified','not_needed')

fork_mirror_revision_start_tested_idx.name: fork_mirror_revision_start_tested_idx
fork_mirror_revision_start_tested_idx.where: state = 'ready' AND readied_at IS NOT NULL

fork_mirror_revision_reason_ck.name: fork_mirror_revision_reason_ck
fork_mirror_revision_reason_ck.value: ("fork_mirror_revision"."reason" IS NULL OR "fork_mirror_revision"."reason" ~ '^[a-z_]{1,64}$') AND ("fork_mirror_revision"."wipe_reason" IS NULL OR "fork_mirror_revision"."wipe_reason" ~ '^[a-z_]{1,64}$')

fork_mirror_revision_hash_ck.name: fork_mirror_revision_hash_ck
fork_mirror_revision_hash_ck.value: "fork_mirror_revision"."plan_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ("fork_mirror_revision"."spec_sha256" IS NULL OR "fork_mirror_revision"."spec_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND ("fork_mirror_revision"."source_view_sha256" IS NULL OR "fork_mirror_revision"."source_view_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND ("fork_mirror_revision"."final_view_sha256" IS NULL OR "fork_mirror_revision"."final_view_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

fork_mirror_revision_final_ck.name: fork_mirror_revision_final_ck
fork_mirror_revision_final_ck.value: state IN ('requested','planning','validating','staging','restoring_files','transforming','restoring_db','starting','healthchecking') OR "fork_mirror_revision"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

fork_mirror_revision_failed_ck.name: fork_mirror_revision_failed_ck
fork_mirror_revision_failed_ck.value: "fork_mirror_revision"."state" NOT IN ('failed','blocked') OR "fork_mirror_revision"."reason" IS NOT NULL

fork_mirror_revision_ready_ck.name: fork_mirror_revision_ready_ck
fork_mirror_revision_ready_ck.value: "fork_mirror_revision"."state" <> 'ready' OR ("fork_mirror_revision"."readied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "fork_mirror_revision"."final_view_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "fork_mirror_revision"."spec_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "fork_mirror_revision"."probe_task_id" IS NOT NULL)

fork_mirror_revision_size_ck.name: fork_mirror_revision_size_ck
fork_mirror_revision_size_ck.value: octet_length("fork_mirror_revision"."steps"::text) <= 65536 AND octet_length("fork_mirror_revision"."services"::text) <= 65536 AND octet_length("fork_mirror_revision"."gates"::text) <= 4096 AND ("fork_mirror_revision"."refusals" IS NULL OR octet_length("fork_mirror_revision"."refusals"::text) <= 8192) AND ("fork_mirror_revision"."spec" IS NULL OR octet_length("fork_mirror_revision"."spec"::text) <= 524288)
